description: Headache Engine — Tri-Axial Model. Three axes (TaiYang, ShaoYang, YangMing) map headache syndromes onto a shared Fascia-Nerve-Vessel UNIT core. Grid state (continuous vs fragmented) is the primary backend discriminator. Aura = suprasystem overlay.
backend_axiom: All headache is neurovascular desynchronisation. The axis determines the pattern; the grid state determines the severity trajectory.

continuous_grid.description: Intact water-EZ tensegrity. Pressure or discharge expression. Pain is sustained, dull, or pressure-dominant.

fragmented_grid.description: EZ instability, sparking edges. Cortical spreading depression substrate. Pain is wave-like, episodic, with sensory phenomena.

nodes.title: Migraine
nodes.ayurvedic_detail: Pitta = Heat, Vascular; Vata = Nerve, Rhythm
nodes.one_liner: Neurovascular rhythm instability (Pitta heat + Vata rhythm).
med_families: CGRP inhibitors: gepants / mAbs — TG vascular overcharge
differentiators: autonomic signs absent or mild (unlike cluster)
aura may or may not precede
what_to_check_next: autonomic signs (tearing, ptosis, rhinorrhea)? → consider TAC overlap

tcm_backend.transition_risk: Shaoyang → Yangming if untreated (nausea, vomiting escalation)
tcm_backend.formula_backend_only: Xiao Chai Hu Tang variant + Yin support if depletion present

nodes.title: Aura
differentiators: gradual march of symptoms (not sudden like TIA)
positive phenomena (lights/tingling) vs negative (loss of vision/sensation)
if >60 min or motor symptoms → red flag
what_to_check_next: first-ever aura in patient >50? → red flag, exclude stroke
aura without headache? → acephalgic migraine, consider cardiac PFO
motor aura? → haemiplegic migraine, specialist referral

tcm_backend.mechanism: Local EZ instability/collapse → electrical discharge propagation
tcm_backend.formula_backend_only: Wu Wei Zi, Bai He, Mai Men Dong for nerve membrane stabilisation

nodes.title: YangMing — TAC / TGN / Cluster / PH / HC
nodes.one_liner: Hyper-energised continuous grid with autonomic discharge.
key_clinical_clues: autonomic signs mandatory for TAC (tearing, rhinorrhea, ptosis, miosis)
what_to_check_next: indomethacin trial → if complete response: PH or HC
MRI to exclude secondary cause (especially TGN)
LFTs and renal function before lithium

tcm_backend.primary_pattern: Shaoyang overload → Yangming discharge. Excess membrane charge exits on intact water grid (eye, ear, nasal discharge).
tcm_backend.mechanism: Vegetative dysautonomia — excess membrane charge exits via intact water grid
tcm_backend.formula_backend_only: Huang Lian Jie Du Tang IF acute heat/toxicity. Avoid long term — too cold, risks Yin drying.

nodes.title: TaiYang — TTH / PRES / IIH
nodes.ayurvedic_detail: Fluid/pressure dominant; blood sludging in posterior fossa
med_families: CSF pressure management (LP, shunt if refractory)
Amitriptyline / duloxetine — chronic TTH tone reset
key_clinical_clues: associated with poor posture, screen load (TTH)
posterior fossa blood sludging in backend model
what_to_check_next: neuroimaging if new, progressive, or atypical

tcm_backend.primary_pattern: Taiyang shell over-tension. Shaoyin return blocked. Water-energy cannot descend.
tcm_backend.formula_backend_only: Fu Ling, Zhu Ling, Mai Men Dong for water-field conduction. Liu Wei Di Huang Wan if Yin depletion.

nodes.title: Fascia–Nerve–Vessel UNIT
nodes.one_liner: Fascia–Nerve–Vessel unit is the gearbox connecting axes.
nodes.description: Central hub where all three axes converge. State of this unit determines which axis is dominant and whether the grid is continuous or fragmented.
nodes.teaching_mode_note: Herbs rebuild grid; Laser dampens chaotic oscillations + recharges grid.

backend_mechanism.fascia: water-structured tensegrity antenna — primary EZ carrier
backend_mechanism.nerve: antenna not the source of error — reflects field state
backend_mechanism.vessel: microcirculatory field-loss compensation — blood sludging indicator

triage_wizard.description: 3-question binary triage. Suggests most likely node with confidence label. Guidance only — not diagnosis.

questions.question: Prominent autonomic signs (tearing / rhinorrhea / ptosis / miosis)?
Aura or visual phenomena before headache?
questions.yes: → HIGH probability: MIGRAINE_GB_TB with AURA_SUPRA overlay

questions.question: Pressure / occipital heaviness worse with lying down or Valsalva?
questions.no: → MEDIUM probability: TAIYANG_BL_SI_TTH_IIH (TTH) or MIGRAINE_GB_TB (without aura)

red_flags: severe headache in pregnancy or postpartum
headache worse with exertion or Valsalva (new pattern)

glossary.TAC: Trigeminal Autonomic Cephalalgia — group of headaches with unilateral pain + ipsilateral autonomic features
glossary.TGN: Trigeminal Neuralgia — brief, electric shock-like facial pain in trigeminal distribution
glossary.TTH: Tension-Type Headache — bilateral pressing headache, muscle-fascia dominant
glossary.IIH: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension — raised CSF pressure without structural cause
glossary.PRES: Posterior Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome — hypertension-related vasogenic oedema
glossary.HC: Hemicrania Continua — continuous unilateral headache, indomethacin-responsive
glossary.CGRP: Calcitonin Gene-Related Peptide — key mediator in migraine; target of modern prophylaxis
glossary.cortical_spreading_depression: Wave of neural depolarisation followed by suppression — physical substrate of aura
glossary.Pitta: Ayurvedic concept: heat, metabolism, transformation — excess = inflammation, vascular overcharge
glossary.Vata: Ayurvedic concept: movement, rhythm, nerve — excess = erratic pain, instability
glossary.Kapha: Ayurvedic concept: structure, fluid, slowness — excess = pressure, congestion, dampness
glossary.ShaoYang: Lateral autonomic axis (GB/TB) — pivot between interior and exterior; lateral antennae
glossary.YangMing: Anterior metabolic axis (ST/LI) — digestion, bulk metabolism, inflammatory discharge
glossary.TaiYang: Posterior sensory axis (BL/SI) — external defence, posterior fascia, pressure/fluid
glossary.grid_fragmentation: Loss of EZ coherence in fascia-water matrix — substrate for aura, sparking, cortical spreading depression
glossary.continuous_grid: Intact EZ tensegrity — pressure or sustained discharge expression rather than fragmentation

disclaimer: Educational model — not a substitute for clinical assessment. Escalate urgent red flags.

shared_diagnosis_map_additions.tcm: Shaoyang → Yangming transition. Excess membrane charge exits via intact water grid (eye, ear, nasal).
shared_diagnosis_map_additions.notes: 100% O2 first-line acute. Verapamil prophylaxis. Autonomic signs mandatory.
Indomethacin absolute response is diagnostic. Shorter attacks than cluster.
Continuous unilateral. Indomethacin absolute response is diagnostic.
Papilloedema = urgent. Acetazolamide first-line. LP if refractory. See Taiyang module.
Hypertension-related. Urgent neuroimaging required. Red flag — do not apply integrative pathway until stabilised.
Visceral fat = stress-adaptation marker. Restore circadian rhythm first. Not a cosmetic target.

shared_rules_additions.action: Route to YANGMING_ST_LI_TAC_TGN node. Consider TAC subtype. Indomethacin trial if attacks short and frequent.
Activate AURA_SUPRA overlay on MIGRAINE_GB_TB node.

shared_rules_additions.condition: headache AND worse_with_Valsalva == true AND papilloedema_present == true
shared_rules_additions.action: URGENT RED FLAG. IIH pathway. Ophthalmology and LP urgently. Do not apply integrative protocol until stabilised.
STOP all integrative pathway. Western medical assessment mandatory first.
Diagnosis: PH or HC confirmed. Maintain indomethacin. Integrative as adjunct only.
Insufficient. Fragmented grid requires EZ stabilisation (membrane support, Yin nourishment, Wu Wei Zi).
Check axis first. Continuous grid (TaiYang) needs pressure reduction not vasodilation. Continuous grid (YangMing) needs discharge reduction.

notes: The Headache Tri-Axial model introduces 'grid state' (continuous vs fragmented) as a new backend variable not present in earlier modules. This must be added to the shared input_variables list.
The Core Unit (Fascia-Nerve-Vessel) is the convergence point of all three axes and should be implemented as a shared node that all headache patterns reference.

TGN maps to the Yangming node in the headache triangle but has its own dedicated module with carbamazepine transition logic — this is clinically critical and must not be merged with general Yangming pattern.
The Metabolic Rhythm module introduces a new clinical entry point (age 40+, pre-disease metabolic dysfunction) and a new positioning language constraint. Fat loss claims are explicitly prohibited.
Carbamazepine-herb interactions are a critical safety rule: carbamazepine is a strong CYP3A4 inducer and reduces multiple drug classes. Any herb formula co-prescription must account for this.
Wu Wei Zi is flagged as KEY for nerve membrane stabilisation in TGN — this should be a required herb whenever EZ instability is the primary mechanism.
The Vitamin D caution (moderate dose only — excess causes neural over-tension) is a new rule not present in earlier modules.
Nigella sativa is flagged as a safe anti-inflammatory that does NOT block Shaoyang — useful when anti-inflammatory support is needed without compromising the ventilation axis.

generic supplement support fascia-noise support (fascia noise), neural noise support (neural noise), restorative sleep support (sleep), cardiometabolic flow support (circulation) are added to the supplement library from TGN module — new products not previously catalogued.
